facts.value: Always clears metal_timer and metal_health. If !is_always_metal, clears is_metal and synchronously calls parameter refresh, collision refresh using current Y scale, rendering restoration, and baseline-bit restoration in that order, even if already inactive. Otherwise leaves is_metal and presentation unchanged rather than forcing active state. The observed external expiry branch requires is_metal && metal_timer != 0, decrements first, and invokes teardown if the resulting timer is zero or health is nonpositive. A zero timer bypasses that health test. Active-status death cleanup and generic fighter-to-fighter state transfer also invoke this routine.
facts.rationale: Replaces the unsupported forced-active implication, incomplete expiry guard, and unverified character-specific transfer claim.

evidence.why: Unconditional resets and guarded ordered teardown.
Generic transfer invokes destination activation before source cleanup.

facts.value: Constructs auxiliary fighter DObjs from fp->ft_data->x5C onto prebuilt indexed part JObjs. Registers descriptor-to-runtime joint references, loads and resolves chains, attaches or appends them, specializes non-null materials to ftMObj, and records auxiliary objects and per-part completion metadata in Fighter state. A specifically Metal-only overlay interpretation remains unresolved.
facts.rationale: Preserves construction mechanics without deriving asset meaning from TU location or rendered aliases.

facts.value: Implements fighter Metal activation and refresh, persistent-state initialization, guarded temporary-state teardown, and eligible-part rendering setup/restoration. Separately constructs descriptor-driven auxiliary DObjs and records them in fighter model bookkeeping; their specific Metal-only gameplay interpretation is not established.
facts.rationale: Separates demonstrated Metal lifecycle from auxiliary construction with unresolved asset identity.
